summary: Evolution Studios' off-road racing series; most entries are PlayStation-only, so preserve PS3 originals for the console games, use PSP/PPSSPP for Arctic Edge's most complete route, and note each online shutdown/DLC caveat.

entries.title: MotorStorm
entries.definitive_edition: Updated PS3 release with preserved DLC

emulation.notes: Use original PS3 hardware for reliability; RPCS3 may improve resolution depending on compatibility.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PS3 or high-resolution PS3 emulation

primary.version: Original PS3 release with updates/DLC if preserved
primary.why: The original MotorStorm is a PS3-only game; its online servers were later shut down, so the best route is the updated disc/digital PS3 release with offline content and any owned DLC.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PlayStation 3 hardware or RPCS3 if compatible; install preserved updates/DLC where legally available and treat online play as unavailable outside community preservation.

entries.title: MotorStorm: Pacific Rift
entries.definitive_edition: Updated PS3 release with preserved DLC

emulation.notes: Use original PS3 hardware for reliability; RPCS3 may improve resolution depending on compatibility.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PS3 or high-resolution PS3 emulation

primary.version: Original PS3 release with updates/DLC if preserved
primary.why: Pacific Rift is a PS3-only sequel; its online servers were permanently shut down in 2012, so the preservation target is the offline PS3 game with any owned content.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or RPCS3 if compatible; install preserved updates/DLC where available and expect official online multiplayer to be unavailable.

entries.remaster_caveats: 3D Rift is a separate mini re-release with 10 tracks, not a full replacement for Pacific Rift.

entries.title: MotorStorm: 3D Rift

emulation.notes: Original PS3 route preserves the stereoscopic 3D intent.

primary.why: 3D Rift is a PSN mini re-release derived from Pacific Rift with 10 tracks, single-player only, stereoscopic 3D focus, and no trophies.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 only if the PSN release is already preserved/owned; do not substitute it for the full Pacific Rift campaign.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mini re-release, not a full remaster or definitive Pacific Rift version.

entries.title: MotorStorm: Arctic Edge
entries.definitive_edition: PSP version plus PS2 split-screen secondary

emulation.emulator: PPSSPP primary; PCSX2 for split-screen secondary
emulation.notes: Use PPSSPP for main play and PCSX2/PS2 only for split-screen comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: High-resolution PSP emulation plus PS2 split-screen route

primary.version: PSP release via PPSSPP or hardware
primary.why: The PSP version has photo mode, custom soundtracks, online play, and online leaderboards, while the PS2 port trades those for split-screen multiplayer; PSP/PPSSPP is the most complete main route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP version on PPSSPP with upscaling or PSP hardware, then sample the PS2 version only for local split-screen multiplayer.

secondary.what_to_play: Use the PS2 version only for split-screen multiplayer sessions.
secondary.why: The PSP version is the content/features primary, but the PS2 version has split-screen multiplayer instead of PSP online features.

entries.title: MotorStorm: Apocalypse

emulation.notes: Use original PS3 hardware for reliability; RPCS3 may improve output if compatible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PS3 or high-resolution PS3 emulation

primary.why: Apocalypse is a PS3-only entry; its multiplayer servers closed in 2018, so the best route is the offline/local PS3 release with its single-player festival and split-screen content.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or RPCS3 if compatible; expect official online multiplayer, online customization, and wagering features to be unavailable.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster documented; Japan release was canceled after the 2011 disaster context.

entries.title: MotorStorm: RC
entries.definitive_edition: PS3 PSN release with Pro-Am and Carnival DLC if preserved

emulation.emulator: PlayStation 3 hardware / RPCS3 if compatible; Vita3K for portable comparison
emulation.notes: Prefer original PS3/Vita ownership because DLC and cross-save behavior are preservation-sensitive.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PS3 output or compatible PS3 emulation

primary.version: PSN release with DLC if preserved
primary.why: RC shipped on PS3 and Vita with cross-save/single-purchase support; the PS3 route has the larger-screen/local play advantage, while the Pro-Am and Carnival DLC add tracks and vehicles if preserved.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 version with Pro-Am and Carnival DLC if owned; use Vita for portable play and cross-save continuity.

entries.remaster_caveats: Digital-only preservation and DLC availability are the main caveats; no modern remaster documented.
